description: This file manages dynamic interactions for a web page, including modal dialogs for editing and adding table columns, and handling print events to preserve button states within a table.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Opens the modal dialog for editing a table column, populating the input with the current column name.

methods.name: addCol
methods.description: Adds a new column to the table with a button that opens the edit modal.

methods.name: saveCol
methods.description: Saves the edited column name and updates the table.

methods.name: deleteCol
methods.description: Removes the selected column from the table.
